PDF Review of - EWA Splatting: A Novel Framework for Volume Rendering Based ...
The reviewed paper introduces the EWA (Elliptical Weighted Average) volume resampling filter, a new splat primitive for volume rendering. It combines an elliptical Gaussian reconstruction kernel with a Gaussian low-pass filter to achieve high-quality antialiasing.
